Please help us share this PhD opportunity with interested candidates.

The PhD, jointly supervised by Kamel Adi (UQO, Canada) and Yacine Sam (University of Tours, France), will explore the orchestration, trust, reliability, and security of AI agents in open and distributed environments, with 18 months in France and 18 months in Canada.

Application deadline: October 15, 2026

Please find the full PhD subject and application details attached.
